parameters.name: BizEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the edge instance. Valid values:

- true: Enable the edge instance.
- false: Disable the edge instance.

If this parameter is left empty, the status is not updated.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the **Edge Instances** page of the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain instance ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the edge instance.
The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and cannot exceed 20 characters in length.

parameters.name: Spec
parameters.description:
The product edition. Valid values:
- 10: Link IoT Edge Lite Edition.
- 20: Link IoT Edge Standard Edition.
- 30: Link IoT Edge Pro Edition.

If this parameter is left empty, the edition is not updated.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description:
Instance tags of the edge instance. Each tag is in the `key:value` format. Separate multiple tags with commas (,). Example: `k1:v1,k2:v2`.
- Limits on tag keys:    
    - Cannot be empty.
    - Must be unique within the edge instance.
    - Can contain only letters.
    - Cannot exceed 20 characters in length.
- Limits on tag values:
    - Cannot be empty.
    - Can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
    - Cannot exceed 20 characters in length (each Chinese character counts as 2 characters).

If this parameter is left empty, instance tag information is not updated.
